prior_seen_period: 2024-03-13 through 2026-11-03; v1 holdout is not fresh evidence
universe: freeze v1 retained 25 Sina industry baskets and their quality-approved contributing stocks; keep v1 eligible-member denominators; no selection by new historical returns
label: next-open to open h sessions later, less CSI300 same-interval return; no trading-cost or fill claims
price_source: Sina compressed full-history OHLCV from repository akshare/Sina fallback source, decoded with installed akshare decoder; all prices adjusted consistently by cached Sina qfq factors; Tencent v1 raw used for independent overlap audit only
train: expanding from 2017 through two calendar years before each test year; every label exit must be within training period
validation: the immediately preceding calendar year, labels must exit within that year
test: one full calendar year, labels must exit within that year; no changes to model specifications after viewing results
ridge_selection: highest validation daily mean 5-day Rank IC, ties choose larger alpha; scaling fitted on training only; train target is same-day centered rank of future excess returns; no sector-ID features
heat_model: replace H by H*exp(-H/0.35)/(0.35/e); weights .25,.25,.20,.15,.15; keep v1 fixed acceleration/decay and use nonmonotonic H in heat interaction
regime_features: benchmark close/MA60 trend as tanh(10*log(close/MA60)); stress as tanh(log(realized_vol20/lagged_252-day_median_vol20)); information available at signal close only
quality_gate: stock >=300 overlapping valid days; >=95% v1 eligible-member daily coverage; >=8 industries per scored day; all model comparisons on identical industry/date and label availability
limit_candidate_rules: ordinary main board10%; ChiNext10% before2020-08-24 and20% after; STAR20%; Beijing30%; reject IPO first20 observed sessions and raw/adjusted return differences>=0.2pp; missing historical ST and exchange reference prices remain explicit limitations
inference: paired 10-session block bootstrap CI; report yearly IC and top-minus-bottom event returns; no annualized trading-return claims
limitations: retrospective historical holdouts, not prospective verification
current surviving constituent selection; historical industry membership unavailable
